verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies background automation. Cloud APIs and client libraries are pitched for automating workflows, Vertex AI is marketed for building agentic systems and enterprise agents, and budgets can trigger programmatic cost-control responses through Pub/Sub. None of it documents setting up scheduled or event-driven automations that run unattended. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or trigger services for background jobs, an explicit autonomous agent-run or background-execution workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
